project_overview: A single continuous five-second observation of an adult painter working at an easel. The intended camera move is a simple physical push forward while the painter keeps working.
visual_direction: Natural studio light and unshowy observational realism.
invariants: One continuous take uses a fixed 50mm focal length throughout, with no optical zoom, dolly zoom, orbit or cuts.
The camera moves straight forward from a medium shot to a tighter view of the painter's face and working right hand, keeping the same three-quarter angle.
The painter remains seated at the same easel, holding the same brush in their right hand and continuing small strokes on the same canvas.
scene_description: During these five seconds the camera gently pushes closer. The seated painter continues painting. The Scene ends while the brush is still making small strokes, rather than adding a reveal or a reaction.
existing_h3_prompt: An adult painter works at an easel. The camera moves closer as they paint.
expected_findings: Specify a physical straight push-in, fixed focal length, unchanged three-quarter angle and continuous five-second action.
Keep seated painter, right-hand brush strokes, same canvas/easel, and face plus hand in the tighter framing.
Avoid dolly-zoom synonyms, opposing zoom/framing instructions, cuts, rack-focus detours or orbiting.
Do not invent a completed painting, dramatic revelation, standing up or stopping work.
